meta.title: I Tested 6 Hotels In Da Nang So You Don't Have To
meta.description:
🇻🇳 I TESTED 6 HOTELS IN DA NANG & HOI AN — SO YOU DON'T HAVE TO!
Which hotels in Da Nang are actually worth the money?
In this video, I test 6 different hotels in Central Vietnam — 4 in Da Nang and 2 in Hoi An — covering different standards, locations and price categories.
I wanted to see what you really get for your money, especially with the rainy season approaching.

🏨 6 HOTELS TESTED
📍 4 Hotels in Da Nang
📍 2 Hotels in Hoi An
💰 Different price ranges & standards
🏊‍♂️ 2 hotels with indoor swimming pools
🌧️ Great options to consider when the weather isn't cooperating
🤫 And one hotel that is literally a SECRET HOTEL!

I'll show you the rooms, facilities, location, atmosphere and what I thought of each hotel — so you can decide which one might be right for your next trip to Vietnam.
Whether you're visiting Da Nang for a few days, staying longer, traveling during rainy season, or planning a trip to Hoi An, hopefully this video helps you get a better idea of what you can expect at different price points.

👉 Which hotel would YOU choose? Let me know in the comments!

Thanks for watching and supporting Gunner Goes Global! 🇻🇳
